Office of Naval and Military Development[/b]

The Government of Sikirsk announces the completion of the first stage in the development of an advanced adaptive command intelligence, created to strengthen the future of national defense. The project has been carried out under strict secrecy with close oversight from both the President, the S.D.S.R, and the Federation Assembly.

The system, named, Adaptive Command Intelligence (A.C.I) is designed to support all-military and missile operations, improve the speed of decision-making, and increase the survivability of Sikirskian forces in major conflict. It analyzes radar and electronic emissions in real time, tracks enemy missile paths, provides countermeasures, and manages supplies across fleets. It can also coordinate electronic warfare and adapt against enemy measures without requiring constant operator input.

Critical functions remain under human control. Safeguards require authorization from designated officials before any strike or escalation can occur. In addition, the system is fully isolated from outside networks, preventing any possibility of external hacking or compromise. This ensures that while the system enhances defense, accountability and control always remain with Sikirskian command.

This development marks a new stage in Sikirsks defensive capacity. The system has entered operational readiness and will stand as a centre of national security in the years ahead.
